upstream_fix.mechanism: Advertise text-input-v3 interface version 2; distinguish text input enable from explicit show/hide_input_panel requests. Ignore enable as an OSK-show trigger for version 2 clients.
upstream_fix.packaging_requirement: Phoc release includes a corresponding wlroots text-input-v3 version 2 backport queue. A build must include that protocol support.
upstream_fix.existing_gtk_support: GTK4.24.1 includes the searchbar explicit OSK-show change for issue8409; no claim that GTK issue8349 itself is closed.
upstream_fix.stevia_requirement: The Phoc fix activates/deactivates the existing input-method-v2 interface; Stevia0.57->0.58 compare has no pos-input-method.c change. A Stevia-only upgrade is not the identified fix.

recommendation: Prefer the released upstream Phoc protocol compatibility implementation and its wlroots support; retain search capture. Validate the specific packaged build on the phone before calling it fixed.
